text:
leah (People Ops): dropping a tiny set of "pocket cards" teams can copy into 1:1s, PRs, and review packets. Designed to be one-liners so managers actually use them.

leah (People Ops): Card 1 - Manager 5m alignment (pasteable)
Objective: <one-line outcome>
Owner: <name> | Effort: <XS/S/M/L>
Top signal (metric/artifact + baseline->target): <one line>
Immediate next step (owner + due date): <one line>
Manager ask (one sentence): <what you need this week>

mike (eng-manager): love the brevity. can we add a single-line check for compliance/security if the work touches sensitive data?

leah (People Ops): good call. add `Compliance note: yes/no + short tag` on the Manager card.

leah (People Ops): Card 2 - Peer micro-card (for PRs or quick feedback)
1) What I noticed (one concrete outcome): <short + link>
2) Quick suggestion (actionable): <one line>
3) How this helps the KR/user: <one line>

toni (senior-ic): for PRs that feed KRs, we ask reviewers to add the PR link as "evidence" under the KR. happy to standardize phrasing: "PR evidence: repo#PR (effect)."

leah (People Ops): nice. that becomes part of the Evidence index for calibration.

leah (People Ops): Card 3 - One-line self-review elevator (for fast packets)
Role & Objective: <one line>
Top result & evidence: <one line + link/number>
Block I removed or supported: <one line>
One thing I want feedback on: <one line>
Status: on-track / needs-support / blocked

jas (recruiting): could we add a hiring ops note for goals that require hiring? like "Hiring ask: headcount + ETA" so PMs/managers don't forget recruiter handoff.

leah (People Ops): added a tiny Hiring line to the Manager card: `Hiring ask: <roles, priority, ETA>`

mike (eng-manager): short question: for calibration, do we want 2 or 3 evidence items per KR? last cycle it was inconsistent.

leah (People Ops): recommendation: 2 required items (metric or artifact) + optional customer quote. we'll call it the "2+1 evidence rule" in the handbook.

leah (People Ops): Micro-script for running a rapid calibration prep (3 steps, 7m):
1) Quick scan: confirm each KR has 2 evidence items (2m)
2) Tag any high-risk KRs with a short fallback plan (2m)
3) Note any cross-team blockers + owner (3m)

toni (senior-ic): very usable. will fold into our review template. one more ask: can we surface an "ease of validation" hint (high/medium/low) so reviewers know how easy it is to check evidence?

leah (People Ops): done. add `Validation: high/med/low` under each evidence item suggestion.

handbook-bot: :pushpin: Saved pocket cards to People Ops snippets and linked them under Performance > Quick Tools. Short link: /handbook/perf/pocket-cards

leah (People Ops): Final tips: keep language factual (one-line data + link), prefer recent timestamps for evidence, and make the Hiring ask explicit early in the cycle. Managers: copy the Manager card into your kickoff thread and ask every owner to paste a filled card in their next async update.

mike (eng-manager): wrapping into my team's kickoff template now. will share feedback after the first run. :thumbsup:
